name: CoreWeave Lancaster AI data center (Lancaster AI Hub)
summary: AI data center development in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, on former LSC Communications printing plant sites, co-developed by Chirisa Technology Parks and Machine Investment Group with CoreWeave as tenant. In July 2025 CoreWeave said it intended to commit about 6 billion US dollars to equip an initial 100 MW facility expandable to 300 MW. Phase one reuses the plant at 216 Greenfield Road and was under construction by October 2025, targeting summer 2027. A new-build phase two of about 735,000 sq ft needed city land development approval; a site at 1375 Harrisburg Pike is also planned. A 4 billion US dollar joint venture with Blue Owl funds the campus.

milestones.note: Announced at the Pennsylvania Energy and Innovation Summit in Pittsburgh.

Demolition at the Greenfield Road phase one site was underway by early August 2025, and phase one was described as under construction in October 2025; it needed no land development plan because it reuses an existing building footprint.
4 billion US dollar joint venture with Blue Owl-managed funds announced.
Phase one completion targeted for summer 2027.
Developer said phase two could be online by mid to late 2027, pending city planning commission land development approval.

power_sources.description: Grid supply from PPL with a proposed new substation and switchyard; the developer says it is spending 200 million US dollars on grid upgrades.
Backup generators for power outages, located mainly between the two Greenfield Road buildings; the fuel is not stated.
